triples.tail_surface: measured close to the operating temperature
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 在接近运行温度时测量
triples.evidence_text: The insulation resistance is to be measured close to the operating temperature.

triples.tail_surface: bridge method or voltage and current method
triples.evidence_text: The resistance of the machine winding is to be measured and recorded, using an appropriate bridge method or voltage and current method.

triples.tail_surface: Tests are to be conducted on generators to verify that the automatic voltage regulation system is capable of achieving the performance described in 4-8-3/3.13.2
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 发电机测试验证自动电压调节系统性能
triples.evidence_text: Tests are to be conducted on generators to verify that the automatic voltage regulation system is capable of achieving the performance described in 4-8-3/3.13.2

triples.tail_surface: measured after running at the output, voltage, frequency and duty for which the machine is rated
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 在额定工况运行后测量
triples.evidence_text: The temperature rises are to be measured after running at the output, voltage, frequency and duty for which the machine is rated.

triples.tail_surface: Tests are to be conducted on generators and motors to demonstrate that their overload and over-current capabilities are as described in 4-8-3/3.7
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 发电机和电机过载过流能力测试
triples.evidence_text: Tests are to be conducted on generators and motors to demonstrate that their overload and over-current capabilities are as described in 4-8-3/3.7

triples.head_surface: generator and its automatic voltage regulation system
triples.head_canonical_zh: 发电机及其自动电压调节系统
triples.tail_surface: sustaining without damage, under steady-state short-circuit condition, a current of three times the rated current for 2 seconds
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 稳态短路条件下承受3倍额定电流2秒无损坏
triples.evidence_text: Tests are to be conducted on AC generators to demonstrate that the generator and its automatic voltage regulation system are capable of sustaining without damage, under steady-state short-circuit condition, a current of three times the rated current for 2 seconds.

triples.tail_surface: withstand without damage a test run at 1.2 times the rated speed for at least 2 minutes
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 1.2倍额定转速超速试验至少2分钟无损坏
triples.evidence_text: AC generators and, where specified and agree upon between purchaser and manufacturer, AC motors are to withstand without damage a test run at 1.2 times the rated speed for at least 2 minutes.

triples.head_canonical_zh: 并励和他励直流电动机
triples.tail_surface: 1.2 times the highest rated speed, or 1.15 times the corresponding no-load speed, whichever is the greater
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 1.2倍最高额定转速或1.15倍空载转速取大者
triples.evidence_text: Shunt-wounded and separately excited motors 1.2 times the highest rated speed, or 1.15 times the corresponding no-load speed, whichever is the greater
